label: Lady Chapel, Ely Cathedral
note: 14th-century stone-vaulted chapel, vault about 18 m high; measured nearly unfurnished in July 2019 with a SoundField ST450, read as FuMa (Info.txt: B-format, Normalised), but the normalisation is unconfirmed: in the direct sound the first-order channels carry 4.8 to 7.7 dB more energy than W, where FuMa gives 3.0 dB and N3D 4.8 dB, so spatial measures from these 8 IRs are not reliable; the ODEON models are the space ca-srir-ec-lc; the sweep covered 50 Hz to 10 kHz, so content above about 9 kHz and the 63 Hz octave are not reliable, and the band-limited and resampled flags come from the sweep, not from resampling; the DRR of R03 (-43.8 dB) comes from an early onset at 13 ms, and from the direct sound at 31.8 ms RIRDB measures about -13 dB

label: Lady Chapel, Ely Cathedral (ODEON models)
note: ODEON models of the chapel in three states, the conditions: 2019 model (validated against the measurements), 1930 model (furnished parish church) and 14c model (original painted state); the 8 measured positions; simulated mid-frequency T30: 5.4 s (2019), 4.9 s (1930), 8.7 s (14c) (I3DA 2021 paper); the B-format is FuMa (direct-sound o1/W +3.0 dB)
